# 皇帝报告者作用域；STAGE为日志阶段。分别记录界面上限计数、脚本计数及实际直属人数。
# 仅供可丢弃测试局；不修改领属或封臣上限，不把直属人数当作计入上限人数。
tca_test_retirement_vassal_snapshot_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = tca_rv_direct value = 0 }
    every_vassal = { root = { change_variable = { name = tca_rv_direct add = 1 } } }
    set_variable = { name = tca_rv_script value = vassal_count }
    debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_VASSAL_$STAGE$ counted=[THIS.Char.GetNumVassalsTowardsLimit] limit=[THIS.Char.GetVassalLimit] script=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.Var('tca_rv_script').GetValue] direct=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.Var('tca_rv_direct').GetValue]"
}
